name: io.github.veracium-ai/veracium
description: Veracium Memory: provenance-aware memory for AI agents: quarantine, abstention gate, supersession.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the reference Anthropic provider

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite memory file (default: veracium.db)

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_USER
environmentVariables.description: The deployment's user id: every tool acts on it; no tool takes a user_id (the host process is the identity boundary)

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_MCP_CAPABILITY
environmentVariables.description: The host's attestation about every call on this server (specs/0031). Unset = none: events default to the third-party class, model-supplied provenance can only restrict, and the seven trust tools refuse every call and write nothing. direct = every call originates in a turn with the authenticated principal and this deployment stands behind the model's authorship labelling as its own; the trust tools then act (look up, correct, dispute, confirm, erase), with erasure on by default, and content relayed in a first-party turn can induce an agent to call them. Attested by the host, not verified by veracium: a server reachable by a public or untrusted agent must leave it unset. Any other value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_MCP_SOURCE_ID
environmentVariables.description: The host's opaque, stable id for the source this deployment ingests from (specs/0006: a mailbox, a connector instance, a device; never a person). Third-party-class events without one are refused (source_id_required), and with VERACIUM_MCP_CAPABILITY unset every event is third-party-class.

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_MCP_ERASURE
environmentVariables.description: Erasure through the agent under direct (specs/0031 §4i): on (the default when unset) or off. off refuses forget_fact and the two-step whole-user erase and leaves the other trust tools working. Any other value, the empty string included, refuses to start.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The package with the MCP SDK and the reference Anthropic provider, which the server needs.

packageArguments.description: `veracium mcp` runs the MCP stdio server (the same server as `veracium-mcp`).
